# parent v0.13.0 - Table of Contents

## Pages

- [Parent](https://parent.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- Core
  - [Parent](https://parent.hexdocs.pm/Parent.md): Functions for implementing a parent process.
  - [Parent.Client](https://parent.hexdocs.pm/Parent.Client.md): Functions for interacting with parent's children from other processes.

- Behaviours
  - [Parent.GenServer](https://parent.hexdocs.pm/Parent.GenServer.md): GenServer with parenting capabilities powered by `Parent`.
  - [Parent.Supervisor](https://parent.hexdocs.pm/Parent.Supervisor.md): Supervisor of child processes.

- Periodic job execution
  - [Periodic](https://parent.hexdocs.pm/Periodic.md): Periodic job execution.
  - [Periodic.Logger](https://parent.hexdocs.pm/Periodic.Logger.md): Telemetry handler that support basic logging of periodic scheduler events.
  - [Periodic.Test](https://parent.hexdocs.pm/Periodic.Test.md): Helpers for testing a periodic job.
